changes: Every Lending Hub item opens its own sheet with how to borrow it, and hands off to Self-Service while it is open.
Every Self-Service form shows the Data Privacy Waiver Statement and asks for consent before it can be sent.
Individual use asks what the item is for, at the desk and on the phone, like USC use.
A Self-Service return whose loan was already closed in Loans can now be cleared, and the list refreshes itself.
The home page is centred, the quantity editor is centred, and the rail's fold chevron sits inside Items with no gold edge.
